advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence does not establish a legal way for a transposed A tile to feed the available panel helper. Its fixed ABI reads A directly and performs its own packing, so transposing a tile first would add repeated work and data movement without changing the helper’s inputs. The direct sixteen-call panel path was already measured and did not show a repeatable gain. A distinct fused experiment would need a compatible consumer or a changed helper layout; neither is supplied as an approved, verified option.
risks: Do not infer a benefit from the smaller panel or from fusing a transpose that the kernel does not consume. Any future layout change must account for all transpose work, panel writes, packing, allocation, calls, and SME transitions in the timed call. No new correctness or performance result is established here.
